'''Star Tours Flight 610''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight traveling to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight status was on time but its gate at the spaceport was changed to Gate 1D. It was set to arrive at 0955 hours and depart again at 1050.
